findings.summary: Four new flags with no issue or feature request first; questions whether this is in scope for ripgrep at all versus a --pre script
No end-to-end test covers the HiArgs wiring of --base64, so regressions pass the suite
'Naturally free of duplicates' comment is false and the test avoids periodic inputs
Docs describe a regex transform and skipped regex parsing that the code does not do; PEM line-wrap caveat missing
--base64 with empty pattern matches nothing while -F '' matches every line
Lean: mutate low in HiArgs instead of threading a tuple
Lean: Base64Mode is Option<Alphabet> spelled by hand
Lean: --base64url may not need to exist; emit both alphabets under --base64
Lean: drop capacity-hint comment and redundant test

why: Finding 1 raises whether the flags belong in ripgrep at all versus a --pre script, which is the maintainer's scope reason in substance, though framed as a question for an issue rather than a firm close. The remaining findings concern tests, docs and size, not scope.
